ValidationRule.description: Throws an error when the Status changes and External System or External Case ID is null.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "ATM_Dispute", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Card_Dispute", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Direct_Debit_Dispute", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Direct_Entry_Dispute", RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPP_Dispute" ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,"Open")), OR( ISPICKVAL(External_System__c,""), ISPICKVAL(External_System__c,"NA"), ISBLANK(External_Case_ID__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required in order to change Status from open - External System and External Case ID.
